integrity: All finite combinatorial checks use explicitly supplied source, exact integer arithmetic and separate finite-field point counts.
scientific_limitations: Arithmetic cones for the diagonal-coordinate family over F7 only; no integral invariant-lattice or full projective-isomorphism classification. The general cubic Frobenius-class tables are established prior work. Priority of the coefficientwise cone table awaits independent assessment.
title: Arithmetic Mori and nef cones of diagonal cubic surfaces over the seven-element field
